::: {.callout-note}
## Why This Memo Matters

This isn't busywork. Research shows that **reflecting on your mistakes** is one of the most powerful ways to learn. Honest self-assessment helps you:

- Identify what you actually understand vs. what you're guessing at
- Build habits that prevent the same mistakes on exams
- Earn credit for engagement even when problems are hard

Your grade depends on **visible reasoning + honest reflection**, not just getting answers right.
:::
